epistemic_role: Exact source-derived local conditional stabilizer instrument for one ideal L=2 two-red-edge path; not a general D4 density channel, production sampler, or schedule evaluation
question: For the pinned short red-X path with first green measurement p2, what are the conditional post-correction blue/green charge probabilities and local stabilizer-state updates after a prescribed matching red-X action?

competing_explanations.unconditioned_support_only: J6E parity support is correct but does not determine conditional blue probabilities from the earlier herald.
competing_explanations.source_stabilizer_instrument: A6/A13/A14 and the stated anticommutation determine both blue outcomes to be equiprobable conditional on either p2, with green vacuum and an explicit replacement of the p2-weighted dressed stabilizer.
competing_explanations.source_gap: If the operator diagrams or anticommutation do not determine the conditional probabilities, retain support only and fail closed on a numerical kernel.

source: Jing et al., Intrinsic Heralding and Optimal Decoders for Non-Abelian Topological Order, https://arxiv.org/html/2507.23765, Appendix A.2 Eq. (A6) and A.4 Eqs. (A13)-(A14), local operator diagrams on PDF printed pages 11 and 13.

fixed_physical_case.first_green_eigenvalue: p2 in {+1,-1}, each 1/2 by A6; public charge bit (1-p2)/2
fixed_physical_case.action: externally prescribed matching red-X correction on [0,4], applied only after the first public measurement; defer is an E2-unavailable control
fixed_physical_case.postflux_eigenvalue: p in {+1,-1} shared by blue vertices 0 and 2; green vertex 1 has +1 bare-star eigenvalue
fixed_physical_case.public_record: full-length binary flux and charge/vacuum arrays only; no physical support, stabilizer generator, p2 label beyond observed first charge bit, or private pairing field

source_stabilizer_transcription: A13 after matching correction has blue-star product B0*B2=+1, bare green star G1=+1, p2-weighted red-Z-dressed green D1 with eigenvalue p2, and the displayed remaining Z-type generator.
The paper states that measuring either blue star anticommutes only with the third, dressed-green generator; thus the first blue outcome p is uniform conditional on p2 and replaces that generator.
A14 after blue measurement has B0=p, B2=p, G1=+1; its local measured-star stabilizers contain no p2 dependence. Do not claim the entire global density operator loses p2 information.
exact_matrix: Enumerate p2=+1/-1 by p=+1/-1; freeze first and postflux public arrays, conditional probability, joint probability, and symbolic generator replacement for all four rows. Check defer has E2 unavailable. Compare the support projection with J6E/J6G.
analysis_rule: Report a source-derived local conditional law and stabilizer update only. Distinguish exact source algebra from a separately implemented D4 lattice tableau. No general-geometry kernel, stochastic history, causal policy, physical schedule risk, LER or threshold claim.
acceptance: All pinned hashes and the L=2 geometry match; A6/A13/A14 source transcription is explicitly audited.
The first p2 branches each have probability 1/2; the two blue p branches conditional on each p2 are 1/2 by anticommuting-generator measurement, giving four joint 1/4 rows.
A13-to-A14 generator replacement removes only the dressed p2 generator, retains bare green +1 and enforces equal blue signs; source-required postflux support agrees with J6E/J6G.
First and second public records are full binary, correction is action-bound, defer has no E2, and no private stabilizer/support field leaks into either public record.
Zero stochastic histories, schedule evaluations and bootstrap replicates; general D4 channel and five-round caller remain frozen.
stop_rule: Fail closed on source-operator ambiguity, pinned hash drift, normalization, support, action binding or public/private separation. Passing closes only the illustrated ideal L=2 local instrument and authorizes a separately registered generalization/adapter gate, not performance sampling.
